facts.fact: The Cabo Verde minister says the Cadastro Social Único, implemented in 2017, is in use, with about 59% of households and 66% of the population classified and validated nationally.
The Cabo Verde minister says about 16 social programmes use the CSU to select beneficiaries, including RSI, social pension, higher-education grants and the social energy and water tariff.
